column1: # content: the relative error of every eigenmode of the lattice operator at the end of the last internal step (the time 20 for IDA; less than one step size after it for CVODE) of the nine integrations of the file t2_steps_runs.csv (checks GS-17 to GS-20): the eigenvalue of the mode
column2: the modulus of the amplitude of the initial state along its eigenvector
column3: the measured relative error of the amplitude (computed amplitude divided by the exact one
column5: the error predicted from the formulas as the integrator applies them (the sum over the steps of the relative error of one step)
column6: the same with every implicit equation solved exactly
column7: and the imaginary part of the error from the rounding of the time variable (minus the eigenvalue times the time defect)
